reason: 变更 562 行 > 200 行阈值（对齐 §12.6 Red Team）

findings.finding: execute.js requires production electron services (pipeline-engine, stage-executor, pipeline-stage-registrars) directly in CLI process. No abstraction or version guard; if modules move/change, CLI breaks at runtime silently via loadProductionDeps catch.
findings.prosecution: execute.js 直接深 require 生产 electron services；模块移动/改名时 CLI 可能在运行期失败，缺少版本守卫。
findings.defense: `loadProductionDeps()` 已用 try/catch 包裹，失败时抛 `INFRA_MISSING`，`runLocalPipeline` 捕获后返回 `FAIL(EXECUTION_SETUP_FAILED)`（测试覆盖 `createEngine` 抛错）；真实运行 `talking-head`/`framework-smoke` 均 PASS。深 require 是本地开发工具的刻意设计：它必须复用生产 `registerAllPipelineStages`，否则会变成第二份接线清单。
findings.rationale: 已有结构化失败路径和真实 PASS 证据；「未来模块移动」会先被构建/测试拦截，不应由执行器维护第二套版本契约。

findings.finding: probeVideo runs execFileSync(ffprobe) on any path returned by extractArtifact. isArtifactPathAllowed only checks root prefix (tmpdir/artifacts), not file-level allowlist; malicious engine context could target any existing file inside allowed roots.
findings.prosecution: isArtifactPathAllowed 只检查 tmpdir/artifacts 前缀，恶意 engine context 可指向允许根内的任意文件，ffprobe 读取其元数据。
findings.defense: 执行器只运行仓内受信流水线代码，engine context 不是外部输入；产物路径还会经过 `fs.existsSync + size>0` 与 ffprobe duration>0。路径限制已阻止跨出临时目录/工作区 artifacts 的访问。
findings.rationale: 威胁模型是本地开发 CLI + 受信引擎；路径前缀 + 存在性 + 大小 + duration 四重校验已覆盖实际风险。

findings.finding: execute.js is 348 lines mixing CLI args parsing, engine setup, video probing, artifact extraction, pipeline execution, and reporting. Tight coupling to production module internals makes future refactoring risky.
findings.prosecution: execute.js 348 行混合 CLI 参数、引擎装配、探测、产物提取与报告，未来重构风险高。
findings.defense: 348 行低于仓库 500 行单文件上限；`pipeline-smoke` 是单命令开发工具，拆成 4 个模块会增加跨文件跳转成本。核心纯函数（buildLocalParams/extractArtifact/isArtifactPathAllowed）已导出并有测试。
findings.rationale: 体量在门禁内，职责围绕单一命令；拆分是风格偏好，不是缺陷。

findings.finding: runLocalPipeline calculates durationMs before artifact extraction and probe; if those steps fail, reported duration excludes time spent in extraction/probing, giving misleading PASS/FAIL durations.
findings.prosecution: durationMs 在产物提取与 ffprobe 之前计算，失败报告的时间不含这两步，可能误导。
findings.defense: durationMs 的语义是「PipelineEngine 执行耗时」，产物提取/ffprobe 是毫秒级后处理；报告同时给出 artifact/probe 字段，读者可区分。真实运行 durationMs=1-6s，探测耗时未影响 PASS/FAIL 判定。
findings.rationale: 字段语义是引擎执行耗时，不是端到端墙钟；不影响判定。若要区分可后续增加 probeDurationMs，但不是当前缺陷。

findings.finding: SUPPORTED_LOCAL_PIPELINES and LOCAL_PARAM_BUILDERS are module-level constants loaded once. If manifest is edited at runtime, execute.js requires full process restart to see updates.
findings.prosecution: SUPPORTED_LOCAL_PIPELINES/LOCAL_PARAM_BUILDERS 在模块加载时固定，运行时改 manifest 需重启进程。
findings.defense: execute.js 是 CLI，每次命令都是新进程；manifest 是仓库内静态文件，不存在运行时热更新场景。测试直接 require 最新 manifest。
findings.rationale: CLI 进程模型下模块级常量是正确做法；热更新不是该工具的运行场景。
